name: Trading Workflow — Pluto Style
description: Three-panel grid for a focused trading session. One Claude pane for trade ideas / setup analysis, one scratch shell for Python data work / backtests, one append-only journal for the running session log. Doesn't run a chart (use TradingView in your browser); this is the AI + analysis + log layer around the chart.

tabs.label: Claude — analysis
startCommands: echo 'ANALYSIS pane: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY then `claude` — paste setup screenshots, ask for confluences, sanity-check theses'
tabs.system_prompt_hint: Trading analysis assistant. Reference ICT concepts (Fair Value Gap, Order Block, Power of Three, Killzones) when relevant. Be direct about probabilities and risk:reward. Don't be a hype man.

tabs.label: Python scratch
startCommands: echo 'SCRATCH: backtest sketches, data pulls, contract math (use python or pwsh)'

tabs.label: Session journal
startCommands: echo 'JOURNAL: append notes with `Add-Content session-log-$(Get-Date -Format yyyy-MM-dd).md "text"`'

env_hints.purpose: Required for the analysis pane. Get one at console.anthropic.com.

notes: TradingView / your charting platform stays in your browser — this pack is the AI + analysis + log layer around it.
Session-log file is dated daily so you can grep across days: `Select-String -Path session-log-*.md 'pattern'`.
